quotes.text: We'll have to start treating the CPR number as just a username, instead of a password. It should never have been "secret" in the first place.
quotes.author: madsohm
quotes.source: Hacker News — Denmark Data Breach Exposes 8.8M People's Personal Data
quotes.extraction_note: Universal security insight — identifiers aren't secrets. Works far beyond Denmark and is exactly the kind of unglamorous pragmatic wisdom this API wants.
